item.title: In 24 hours, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Meta turned AI into a race to the bottom on price

For example, when a client wanted their chatbot to answer questions about authentication choices, the system needed to retrieve relevant prior conversations effectively. If it fails to find the right context, answers may rely on implementation details rather than informed discussions. The…
